note: Adjudicated accidental variants (punctuation): one at the showing of the Host and one repeated in each of the three petitions. Substantive text agrees across both witnesses with zero divergence.

adjudicated.ruling: No comma after the second ecce, with handmissal-eo and with the 1962 typical edition. The relative clause is what the second ecce points at — behold Him who takes away — and cannot be cut loose from it.

Comma, with do and with the 1962 typical edition, which prints the people's petition this way. The corpus sets a colon at ordinarium.panem-caelestem w016, where both witnesses print one: the same sentence is pointed differently in the two places, and the edition follows each page rather than levelling them. The same ruling governs w034 and w051.
